notes.title: Don t take it personally, dear, it just ain t your story: Seduce Me 2: The Demon War review
notes.content:
Join Ella McConnell for Waifu Material, a monthly column in which she navigates the murky, cherry-blossom-strewn waters of visual novels, dating sims, and everything in between (reader masochism not required but strongly recommended). [Content warning: brief mention of suicide and sexual assault as themes dealt with in the game but no further discussion thereof.]

When I first started my Tumblr-based visual novel review blog, Seduce Me had the dubious honour of being the very first one I ever reviewed and now it s time to go back to my roots.
(more…)

notes.title: SEDUCE ME 2: THE DEMON WAR IS ON STEAMGREENLIGHT!
notes.content:
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=654940714
Make sure to come and vote for us so we can release it on May 20th via Steam!! Spread the word!

Thanks very much!

~The Seduce Me team

--- ABOUT THE GAME ---

I was supposed to be happy. I was supposed to get married to the man I loved. 

Why am I in the Demon World!? 

---- 

Seduce Me 2: The Demon War is the sequel to the popular free-to-play otome game, Seduce Me the Otome. It follows the story of Mika Anderson as she is suddenly thrown into the Abyssal Plains right before she is about to be married to one of the five Incubi Brothers featured in the first game. What’s even worse is that she is thrown there in the middle of a Rebellion against the Evil Demon Lord and must not only assist Diana and the Rebel Leaders in the war, but must watch as the man she loves fights alongside them after he comes to rescue her. 

----- 

Seduce Me 2: The Demon World is a visual novel, an interactive story that combines graphics, music, and sound effects. Throughout the game, you will make a multitude of choices that will affect your relationships with other characters and ultimately what ending you'll end up at. 

-Five individual stories to follow! 
-Full English Voice Acting! 
-Custom GUI 
-Original Soundtrack 
-MULTIPLE endings (including some BAD ENDS DUN DUN DUUUUUUN) 
-The original and lovable demon (James, Erik, Sam, Matthew, Damien, and Diana) romance routes CONTINUE!! 
-Unlockable Bloopers!

notes.title: Soundtracks have been found! - Bug Fix!
notes.content:
Hello! We recently found out that the Music Soundtrack was accidently programmed to give out the Otome CD soundtrack, giving people the wrong album! We very quickly just fixed that so now you can find the DLC you properly purchased =) Just make sure to update your DLC!

-----To Find Your Music!----

Steam will install the game soundtrack to your computer. The paths are as follows:

Windows: Please use your computer's File Explorer to navigate to the soundtrack 
C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\SteamApps\common\ 
Locate the game folder and the soundtrack will be within it.

Mac: Open the Finder Window and press Command+Shift+G (or select Go > Go to Folder...). Enter "~/Library/ Application Support/Steam/" (without quotes), then press Enter. Locate the Steam Apps folder, open it and locate the Common folder, open it. Locate the game folder and the soundtrack will be within it.

Linux: Using Terminal -
~/.local/share/Steam/SteamApps/common/
Locate the game folder and the soundtrack will be within it.

notes.title: Seduce Me Otome CD and Soundtrack - Coming Soon!! =D
notes.content:
Hey guys! Michaela here =D

I just wanted to announce that we will be uploading the Seduce Me Otome CD and the Seduce Me Otome Music Soundtrack up sometime this week or next! 

"Michaela! What's the difference between the CDs?" Well~

The Music Soundtrack has all of the music involved with the game, including the OP "Chained the Monster" and the ED "Fly High"! The entire soundtrack will be $10 to purchase =)

The Otome CD is a much more interesting experience~

WATCH THE TRAILER OF IT HERE:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_la2GjnpUmE
"What would have happened if you let the boys stay and you couldn't decide which boy to like? Well, a few months after Malix is defeated, you find out!"

This is an audiodrama CD made just so you can bring the boys with you where-ever you go via your music player! They are designed after Japanese Boyfriend CDs where you listen and immerse yourself into an audio world with your love interest talking to you, serenading you, or even KISSING YOU!!

This include 15 tracks of incubi goodness, a blooper track, and 5 behind the voices tracks with all 5 of the incubi! (21 tracks in all!!!) The 15 tracks will also be STEREO MIXED, so you will be able to enjoy the 'presence' of the incubi's voices AS IF THEY WERE SITTING NEXT TO YOU (So make sure to wear headphones~ ;3)

The Otome CD will be $5 to purchase and enjoy!

----

Hope we can get it out soon! Stay tuned <3

~Michaela

notes.title: Seduce Me: Shall We Dance? - Sam's Epilogue
notes.content:
—Sam's New Official Epilogue for Seduce Me—

http://vamichaelalaws.itch.io/seduce-me-the-otome-shall-we-dance

"I Want To Be Worthy Of You."

Sam and I have been living together for almost 2 years. He's worked in the Police Force and I couldn't be happier.

Why did Sam want me to wear this dress, though, and where was he taking me?

——————————-

Hey everyone! So, we made this episode a long while ago and wanted to share it with the Steam crowd following Seduce Me! However, because this episode is essentially a separate game from the main game, we can't put it on Steam as a DLC or the like.

So we have provided a link to the DRM-free download link at the itch.io link above! It is FREE TO DOWNLOAD, with the option to donate to the game as 'payment' =)

We hope you enjoy Sam's epilogue!

-Michaela, the creator of Seduce Me

notes.title: Orion - A Sci-fi Visual Novel on Steam Greenlight!
notes.content:
Heyo everyone!

We hope you enjoy/enjoyed/are enjoying Seduce Me the Otome! If you aren't, we apologize, but there are many stories to enjoy on Steam!

We want to show off one story we believe should get on Steam!

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=457712765

Orion is a science-fiction visual novel exploring the nature of time, technology, and the human desire for power. It has a magnificent team and we would be so happy if everyone could help get it on Steam by voting 'Yes' for it!

That's all for now!

~Michaela Laws, Writer and Creator of Seduce Me
